extensionDescription.message: A local LLM translates pages on your device. Free, no account.

tagline.message: Page translation that runs on your device

diagRateHint.message: While a page is translating, its bar shows tokens/s and segments/s.

paceHelp.message: Translates paragraphs just before they scroll into view. "Look ahead further" prefetches more below the fold, so the text is ready when you scroll. For the languages PLaMo supports, every line comes from PLaMo; Chrome's draft is never used.

unofficialNotice.message: Unofficial. Not affiliated with Preferred Networks. Built with PLaMo.

optionsLead.message: Choose how translation works, manage the model, and set per-site behavior. Changes save automatically.

privacyBody.message: Translation text is sent to LM Studio on this device, not to an external cloud service.

privacyDestinations.message: The API connection is restricted to localhost.

licensesBody.message: The full PLaMo Community License and this extension's MIT license are bundled with the extension.

licenseModelNote.message: Model weights are not bundled. Install them separately in LM Studio.

machineTranslationNotice.message: Translations are machine translations produced by PLaMo.

onboardingLead.message: Page translation runs on your device. The PLaMo 3 model downloads only when it is not already stored on this device.

onboardingModelNote.message: The default model (573 MB) downloads to this device. A sustained 100 Mbps transfer of that size is about 46 seconds before overhead; real time varies. An interrupted download resumes.

onboardingBridgeNote.message: The page keeps its original text until the model is ready, then PLaMo translates it. Google documents Chrome's translation as on-device.

onboardingPrivacyNote.message: This extension does not send page text to a server.

onboardingStart.message: Agree to the license and start

onboardingStartFailed.message: Setup could not start. Please try again.

onboardingHttpError.message: The model download failed (HTTP $STATUS$). Please try again.

commandTranslate.message: Translate this page or restore the original

commandBilingual.message: Translate in bilingual view, or switch the current view

pageStartBlocked.message: Page translation waits until the PLaMo model finishes downloading and loads. Open onboarding to see the progress.

pagePartial.message: $BLOCKS$ parts of this page could not be translated.

siteGrantBody.message: Pages on $HOST$ will be translated on this device.

siteGrantDenied.message: Permission was not granted. Try again.

siteGrantInvalid.message: This page does not name a site.

targetAdjustedNote.message: The page is already in the saved target language, so the target was switched.

sameLanguageHint.message: This page is already written in the target language.

displaySiteHint.message: This choice is remembered for the site.

displayNowBilingual.message: Bilingual view is on for this site.

displayNowReplace.message: Replacement view is on for this site.

optionsDefaultHint.message: These are the defaults. A site you translate can keep its own language and reading style.

optionsSiteLive.message: Language and reading style here follow the site. The settings above are used when a site has no choice of its own.

shortcutHelp.message: When Chrome leaves a command unbound, the default key still works on pages. Uncheck a command here to turn it off. Use Change shortcuts to edit Chrome’s own bindings.

shortcutFallbackNote.message: Chrome has no key for this command, so the default is used on pages.

shortcutTranslate.message: $KEY$ translates the page or restores the original.

shortcutBilingual.message: $KEY$ switches between replacement and bilingual view, and remembers the choice for this site.

runtimePlamoGpuFallback.message: PLaMo · CPU (WebGPU could not load the model)

runtimeError.message: The model could not be loaded

onboardingStartNotice.message: Pressing "Agree to the license and start" means you agree to the whole PLaMo Community License.

onboardingCommercialBody.message: This includes using it for work inside a company. Both of the following are required.

onboardingCommercialRevenue.message: Income or sales for you or your affiliates in the most recent fiscal year of 1 billion yen or less

onboardingCommercialUnmetHeading.message: When the conditions are not met

onboardingCommercialUnmetBody.message: Commercial use then needs a separate license from PFN.

onboardingAgeNotice.message: If you are under 18 or otherwise not old enough to enter a contract on your own, a parent or guardian's consent is required.

onboardingConsentSentence.message: Pressing "Agree to the license and start" means you agree to the PLaMo Community License.

onboardingReconsentHeading.message: The PLaMo terms are now easier to read

onboardingReconsentBody.message: You agreed to the PLaMo Community License earlier. Here is the clearer summary of the terms, so you can agree once more. Your downloaded model stays on this device.

onboardingUseNow.message: Chrome's built-in translator is used only for the language pairs PLaMo does not support.

onboardingReadyLead.message: You can translate pages on this device.

onboardingReadyToolbar.message: Click the toolbar icon to translate the open page.

onboardingReadyPage.message: Press $KEY$ to translate the whole page. Press it again to restore the original.

onboardingReadyContext.message: Right-click the page and choose "Translate this page". For selected text, choose "Translate the selected text".

onboardingWhileDownloading.message: While the model downloads, pages keep their original text; nothing is translated until PLaMo is ready.

downloadResuming.message: The download is continuing from where it stopped.

downloadPaused.message: The download is paused. It can resume where it left off.

highQualityOffer.message: You can try the higher-accuracy model (2B, about 1.81 GB). Speed depends on this device.

glossaryHelp.message: Write one “source,translation” pair per line. Choose a site to use the list only there.

cacheClearFailed.message: The translation cache could not be cleared.

idleLabel.message: Release the model from memory after

tierHelp.message: Automatic picks the mode that fits this PC.

slowDeviceHint.message: PLaMo is slow on this PC. Each paragraph appears as the model finishes it.

errorPermission.message: Permission for this site was not granted.

typedLead.message: Type or paste text and translate it with the same PLaMo model the page translation uses. Nothing leaves this device.

typedPlaceholder.message: Type or paste the text here.

typedTooLong.message: This text is too long for one request. Shorten it to $LIMIT$ characters or fewer.

typedDirectionHint.message: Translates into $LANGUAGE$. Other languages are detected automatically.

typedCopyFailed.message: Could not copy the translation. Select it and copy it yourself.

typedResultEmpty.message: The PLaMo translation appears here, beside the text you pasted.

typedRunHint.message: Ctrl+Enter (⌘+Enter on a Mac) translates too.

typedFailed.message: The text could not be translated. Your text is unchanged; try again.

typedNeedsConsent.message: PLaMo needs a one-time licence agreement before it can run. Your text is not translated until then.

typedModelMissing.message: The PLaMo model is not on this device yet.

typedModelPartial.message: The PLaMo model download was interrupted.

typedModelBusy.message: The PLaMo model is downloading. Translation starts once it is ready.

typedModelError.message: The PLaMo model could not load. Open the options page to check it.

typedChromeOnlyTarget.message: Typed translation uses PLaMo only, and PLaMo does not translate into $LANGUAGE$. Pick another language here, or translate a page for the built-in translator.

typedChromeOnlyNote.message: Chrome's built-in translator covers $LANGUAGES$ on pages only; typed text is never sent to it.

commandCompose.message: Translate the text you are writing

shortcutCompose.message: $KEY$ translates the text in the field you are typing in.

onboardingReadyCompose.message: Press $KEY$ while typing in a message box to preview a translation you can apply.

composeHelp.message: While a message box is focused, the あA button (or the shortcut) previews a translation of what you are typing. Japanese drafts go to English (or to the target language above); other drafts use that target. Nothing is replaced until you choose Replace.

composeEmpty.message: Start typing to see a translation.

composeTooLong.message: This draft is too long to translate.

composeReplaced.message: Replaced. You can restore the original.

composeChromeOnly.message: Draft translation uses PLaMo only, and PLaMo does not translate into $LANGUAGE$.

composeIconSetting.message: Show the あA button on message boxes

composeIconSettingHelp.message: The shortcut and the right-click menu still work when the button is hidden.

composeTargetAuto.message: Auto (Japanese drafts go to the other language of the pair; otherwise the page target)

composeTargetSettingHelp.message: The language you last picked in the compose preview is remembered here.

composeInstantSetting.message: Translate and replace with one shortcut press

composeInstantSettingHelp.message: Skip the preview: one shortcut press translates the draft and replaces it. Undo is still available.

composeNeedSetup.message: PLaMo is not ready yet. Open setup to agree to the licence and download the model.

composeLoading.message: The PLaMo model is loading. The preview will appear when it is ready.

composeStale.message: The draft changed. Replace is paused until the preview catches up.

composePlacementSettingHelp.message: The default for every site. Drag the ⋮⋮ grip on the bar to park it anywhere on this page. The ⋯ menu can also override this for that site only.

composePlacementFollowSettings.message: Use the setting for all sites

composePlacementHandle.message: Drag to move the bar anywhere

lmPortInvalid.message: Enter a port number from 1 to 65535.

lmUnavailable.message: Cannot connect to LM Studio. Start its local server and check the port.

lmTimeout.message: LM Studio did not respond in time.

lmInvalid.message: LM Studio returned an invalid response.

lmHttp.message: LM Studio returned an API error. Check the server.

lmNoModels.message: No models found. Install a model in LM Studio.

lmModelMissing.message: The selected model is not in the model list.

lmModelHint.message: Model availability does not indicate whether it is loaded. Load the model in LM Studio.

lmError.message: Translation failed. Check that the LM Studio server is running and the selected model is loaded.

lmPageConnectionFailed.message: Cannot connect to LM Studio. Start the local server and check the port in settings.

lmEmpty.message: LM Studio returned an empty translation.

lmTruncated.message: The translation was cut off. Try a shorter text.

lmModelFailed.message: The selected model was not found or could not be loaded. Check LM Studio and select a model in settings.

lmCommunication.message: The extension could not communicate with its translation process. Reload the extension and try again.

lmAutoDirection.message: Automatically switch between Japanese and English
